source.name: SportsPro, 'PSG renew Qatar Airways shirt sponsorship on same terms'
source.quote: Qatar Airways logo will continue to feature on Ligue 1 club's playing shirts, training apparel and warm-up kits

source.name: VERSUS — 'SNIPES Becomes Paris Saint-Germain's Culture and Community Partner'
source.quote: The German streetwear giants' branding will feature on the back of PSG kits going forward

source.name: Economy Middle East — 'BEYOND Developments becomes Paris Saint-Germain's new premium sleeve partner until 2029'
source.quote: Under this multi-year agreement, BEYOND becomes the Club's Premium Sleeve Partner until 2029

summary: Nike kit. Qatar Airways (state-owned) on the front through 2028; Snipes (Deichmann Group) on the back; Dubai developer BEYOND Developments (OMNIYAT GROUP) as premium sleeve partner until 2029. Shorts and patch placements not checked.
